heroDescription: Whether you have a question about a listing, need help claiming your profile, or want to partner with us, we'd love to hear from you.
sectionHeading: Our standard is simple: would we hire them for our own homes?
paragraph1: Finding a reliable contractor, cleaner, or landscaper in Edmonton takes more digging than it should. We wanted a site built specifically around that, a focused, local guide to home services, instead of one small category buried inside a directory that also covers restaurants, salons, and everything else.
paragraph2: So we do it the slow way. A real person looks into every business before it goes on the site, nothing gets pulled in bulk from a database. We check that they're actually operating in Edmonton, note licensing and insurance when a business makes that public, and write our own honest description instead of copying whatever's already out there. Paying for a featured spot doesn't change any of that. Every business gets held to the same bar.
statCaption: Locally owned and operated in Edmonton, Alberta.
